hypothesis: A smooth, persistent 60-day price trend may carry more reliable information than raw momentum: high trend efficiency means the net move is large relative to the accumulated daily path, while noisy or choppy moves are penalized. Combining this signal with defensive quality and cash quality may improve returns without sacrificing recent-year downside control.

factor.formula: net log return over 60 returns divided by the sum of absolute daily log returns over the same 60 returns; null when the path sum is non-positive
factor.returns: adjusted close-to-close log returns from kline_daily_enriched
factor.direction: higher is better; values are bounded by [-1, 1]
factor.point_in_time: signal date t uses returns through close t; execution remains T+1 open
factor.rationale: Kaufman-style trend efficiency rewards a persistent directional path and penalizes noisy round trips; it is not a raw return, volatility, skew, or volume factor.

control_strategy.purpose: Matched universe, factor availability filter, and execution; trend efficiency is not a score component.

execution.universe: historical HS300 membership; monthly snapshots for 2018-2020 and daily snapshots from 2021

samples.recent_12m: last 252 trading-day returns of the stitched 2018-2026 curve
samples.rolling_1y: 252-trading-day rolling compounded return over the stitched 2018-2026 curve

gates.D1: factor coverage within historical HS300 membership over 2018-2026 is at least 90%
gates.D2: first valid value occurs after at least 60 return observations and recent-12m coverage is at least 95%
gates.G1: independent 2018-2020 total return is at least control + 5pp
gates.G2: independent 2018-2020 MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G3: validation 2021-2024 total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample rolling-1y positive rate is at least control
gates.G5: full-sample MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G6: full-sample total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G7: recent 12m total return is positive and recent 12m MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp

decision_rule: All D and G gates must pass. The 60-return window, direction, score weights, stock count, holding period, and stop loss are frozen before results; no post-result relaxation is allowed.
known_limitations: Trend efficiency is a price-path statistic and may correlate with momentum or low volatility; the matched control isolates the score contribution but does not prove an orthogonal risk premium.
2018-2020 HS300 membership uses monthly snapshots, so intra-month index changes are not modeled.
The factor is research-only until every preregistered gate passes.
revision_note: The initial draft specified simple returns and incorrectly stated a [-1,1] bound. Before factor generation or market backtesting, the definition was corrected to daily log returns so net log return divided by absolute log-return path is strictly bounded by one. Formula, gates, weights and sample split are otherwise unchanged.
